//! A tiny ring buffer for fixed-size metric windows.
//!
//! The window never allocates after construction, which is the point: the
//! collector runs on the hot path and must not surprise the allocator.

use std::collections::VecDeque;

/// Holds the last `cap` samples pushed to it.
pub struct Window {
    samples: VecDeque<f64>,
    cap: usize,
}

impl Window {
    /* new builds a window that remembers exactly cap samples. */
    pub fn new(cap: usize) -> Self {
        Window {
            samples: VecDeque::with_capacity(cap),
            cap,
        }
    }

    /// Push a sample, evicting the oldest once the window is full.
    pub fn push(&mut self, value: f64) {
        if self.samples.len() == self.cap {
            self.samples.pop_front();
        }
        self.samples.push_back(value);
    }

    /// Mean of the window, or 0.0 when nothing has been pushed yet.
    pub fn mean(&self) -> f64 {
        if self.samples.is_empty() {
            return 0.0;
        }
        let sum: f64 = self.samples.iter().sum();
        sum / self.samples.len() as f64
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut window = Window::new(60);
    for i in 0..60 {
        window.push(i as f64 * 1.5);
    }
    println!("mean over the last minute: {:.2}", window.mean());
}
